title: Energy Engine Plant Physics Modules
description: Create 8 Rust source files for energy_engine at energy/engine/rs/src/: plant.rs, shw.rs, solar_thermal.rs, refrigeration.rs, electrical.rs, water.rs, faults.rs, curves.rs with real physics, emoji docstrings, regions, tests, and wire into lib.rs.
summary: Added 8 plant/specialized physics modules to energy_engine: plant (loops, pumps, boilers, EIR/absorption chillers, heat pumps, cooling towers, HX, GSHP, thermal storage), shw (mixed/stratified/HP water heaters, fixtures, standby, drain recovery), solar_thermal (flat-plate, ICS, unglazed transpired, PVT with collector_thermal_output_w), refrigeration (display cases, walk-ins, compressor racks, condensers, secondary loops), electrical (loads, PV, wind, generators, inverters, batteries, transformers, grid balance), water (fixtures, tanks, rainwater, condensate, irrigation, cooling tower makeup), faults (sensor offsets, fouling, damper/refrigerant charge faults with severity schedules), and expanded curves (linear–triquadratic polynomials, CurveLookupTable2D wrapper, validation). Wired all modules into lib.rs. Fixed zone_air moisture capacitance typo blocking compile. All 49 new module tests pass.
